sources.entry: R Graphics Cookbook by Winston Chang

summary.name: R Graphics Cookbook, 2nd edition
summary.one_liner: A recipe-style book by Winston Chang that teaches how to make high-quality graphs in R, readable free online.
use_cases: learning to make graphs in R
finding a solution to a specific R plotting problem
summary.what_it_does: The book offers more than 150 recipes for generating graphs in R. Each recipe addresses a specific problem and provides a solution that can be applied to the reader's own project. Each recipe also includes a discussion of how and why the solution works. The text is aimed at scientists, engineers, programmers, and data analysts. The page says it can be read online for free.
notable: More than 150 recipes, each with a problem, solution, and explanation
Physical copy available for purchase on Amazon
caveats: Physical copy must be bought on Amazon; the page does not give a price
Covers R graphing only; the page does not mention other languages or tools
